currency.basis: For this historical record the relevant period is the bank's final operating period: the archived asset dates to 2020-12-25, within the 2020 branding period that ended with the merger into Росбанк (ceased 2021-03-01 per the CBR registry).

identity.basis: The lockup is served from api.rusfinancebank.ru, the bank's own API domain, and archived during the bank's operation; the symbol matches the emblem depicted by the accepted icon.

assessment.independenceRationale: First-party asset provenance (bank's own API domain via the Internet Archive) corroborated by the independent CBR registry for lifecycle; the mobile header variant (separate file, sha256 5a4ad6f8683d…) shows the same symbol, supporting the extraction.
uncertainties: The original site is offline; the official asset is preserved through Internet Archive captures, so current on-site use cannot be observed — irrelevant for a defunct-brand record whose relevant period ended 2021-03-01.

variant.basis: Standalone symbol variant (red block over black block with white slot) extracted from the header lockup; this is the same emblem the accepted icon depicts, without wordmark lettering.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The symbol has three flat blocks; all edges are crisp and complete in the final renders; the white slot is preserved exactly as authored in the source (white paint, narrower than the blocks), not redrawn or erased.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The near-square symbol viewBox (26.933 x 26.988 units) is preserved with no scaling or translation beyond the authored geometry; the full-bleed composition fills the cell as in the accepted icon; legible and recognizable at 24/32/48 px on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Replace the accepted icon with the standalone symbol of the bank's final-period official header logo vector: it corrects the off-brand palette (#de4149/#221f20 → official #E4032E red and black with the white slot) and is backed by an original first-party vector, archived during the bank's operation (merged into Росбанк effective 2021-03-01, so 2020 branding is the relevant period).
candidate.role: Standalone symbol mark: red block over black block with a white slot — the emblem part of the official lockup, without wordmark lettering; the blocks themselves are the whole emblem, no separate backing.
transforms: Lossless whole-element selection from the original lockup vector: the three symbol paths (red block, black block, white slot) are carried over verbatim; a square viewBox bounds the symbol; no path data, color or geometry was edited; no transformation of the emblem was needed.

candidate.variant: Symbol variant of the 2020 'БУДУЩЕЕ ЭТО ТЫ' lockup; the accepted icon already depicts this same symbol variant, so only palette/provenance change, not a redesign.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Palette correction: the accepted icon's softened red #de4149 and dark-gray #221f20 with a transparent notch are replaced by the official vivid #E4032E red and black with the source's white slot; on a light background both render similarly, but the official colors are visibly more saturated and the slot is white rather than background-colored on dark themes — matching the archived official asset.

proposals.reason: The accepted icon approximates the bank's final-period official mark with off-brand colors: baseline #de4149/#221f20 versus the official #E4032E red and black. The official desktop header logo SVG (served by the bank's own API api.rusfinancebank.ru, archived by the Internet Archive on 2020-12-25) is a genuine original vector whose standalone symbol (red block over black block with white slot) is square-cell suitable; extracting it corrects the palette while preserving the emblem geometry. Historical record: the bank merged into ПАО Росбанк (CBR decision 17.12.2020, ceased 01.03.2021), so the 2020 branding is the relevant period; the current РФК-банк is a different entity.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original vector of the final-period brand; its standalone symbol corrects the accepted icon's off-brand colors (#de4149/#221f20 → official #E4032E/black with white slot) while preserving the emblem composition.

sources.independenceGroup: Rusfinance Bank first-party assets via Internet Archive
